en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A Jew or a Christian had four thousand Dirhams for him in my possession, so he died. Is it allowed for me that I reconcile with his inheritors or (otherwise) don’t let them known how much it was?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, until you inform them’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. ‘There are four thousand dirhams of a Jew or a Christian and he has died. Is it permissible to reach a settlement about it with his heirs without informing them of the amount?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, until you inform them of the amount.’”
